newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firms as holidays affect settlement dates.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firms as holidays affect settlement dates.

text.p: The rouble firmed in lively trading on Monday as banks started to seek roubles before the Constitution Day holidays and the resulting seven-day working week next week, dealers said.
December 12 and 13 are market holidays in Russia, while Saturday and Sunday December 14 and 15 are working days.
roubles/dollar Dec 9 midday Dec 9 early Dec 6 close

"It is better to be in roubles now as we are not working on Thursday and Friday, while it will not be possible to work with dollars during the weekend. The earlier you come out of dollars, the smaller losses you will have," one dealer said.
Russian banks use U.S. counterparties for settlement.
Dealers said a fall in prices on the government securities market meant the rouble was not receiving its usual support from that quarter.
The rouble traditionally firms on Mondays and Tuesdays ahead of the weekly T-bill auctions on Wednesdays, as investors seek rouble funds to buy the paper.
